# Changelog — SS14 Tartarus

Dated record of what changed in the event (patches, hotfixes, community-measured data, simulator versions).
"(automatic)" entries are generated by `scripts/update_data.py`; manual ones cite a source.

Sources to monitor:
- Official patch notes: https://torchlight.xd.com/ss14pn (`?lang=en`) — check whether a new "补充日志"/supplemental log appears
- Steam news (appid 1974050): https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1974050
- Simulator/guide (updates with live reports): https://blahdot3h.github.io/tartarus-simulator/strategy.html
- Original CN simulator: https://torchlightskill.com/talos/ (author on Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/39881994)
- tlidb: https://tlidb.com/en/Tartarus_Season
- r/TorchlightInfinite, NGA 火炬之光无限 board

## 2026-10-16 — baseline (season day 1)

**Official**
- Season SS14 Tartarus (塔罗斯的困兽) live: Oct 15 19:00 PDT = Oct 16 10:00 GMT+8.
- Patch notes include a 10/14 supplemental log that overrides the main text (followers: Lone Wolf buff; Focused Strike 4→6 stacks; Full Suppression +50%→+20%; Youga 3 Core auto-summon 10 m/0.1 s; Realm Beyond Reach drops globally in Profound+).
- Tartarus no longer drops Nether King's Broken Divinity; Nether King's Divinity drops much more often and can be traded.

**Measured live (community, compiled in the simulator)**
- Rarity odds behind a door: 40/38/12/8/2 (N/M/R/L/S), n=1,011 doors. *Before the measurement the simulator used 52/27/15/6/0.*
- Replace odds: 52/32/9/6/1.5, n=261.
- Second meal from Legendary up (Mammoth also eats Wolf; Lion also eats Rat): seen 3× live.
- "Cancel" stops a consumption chain after any bite.
- The game gives **1** instrument choice at the start (not 3 picks).
- Objectives seen: King of the Caged, Prison Walk (18 tiles), Survival of the Fittest (consume 4×), Undercurrents (2 incidents).
- Pre-run cards seen: Cage Fight, Iron Law (30 days), Tyranny.

**Simulator**: version `20261016zzc` (snapshot in `data/snapshots/sim_20261016zzc.json`).
- Optimal strategy: 3.43 Rainbows/run with rewards; 0.98 without instruments.
- Best solo instrument: Iron Crown (2.71). Best pair: Hangman's Noose + Severed Iron Maiden (15.45).

## 2026-10-16 (night) — live telemetry incorporated

Source: `rates.json` from the simulator repo (https://github.com/blahdot3h/tartarus-simulator, `beta/data/rates.json`) — 38,011 boards, 5,873 runs shared by players via the board analyzer. Now pulled by `scripts/update_data.py`.

- Door (n=7,191): Normal 41.8% · Magic 35.9% · Rare 11.4% · Legendary 9.2% · Supreme 1.8% (the 1,011 sample gave 40/38/12/8/2).
- Beast behind the door: Mammoth 24.1% · Lion 23.2% · Wolf 26.3% · Rat 26.4% (slightly off 25%, p≈0.00007).
- Replace (n=696): Normal 42.2% · Magic 33.3% · Rare 14.5% · Legendary 7.3% · Supreme 2.3% · **Rainbow 0.3%** (2 seen). *Corrects the 261 sample (52/32/9/6/1.5): Replace is nearly the same as a door, not worse.*
- Mornings with only 2 doors: **16.9%** (n=8,592); the simulator assumed 0%.
- Doors with an event on day 1: **6.4%** (n=10,370); the simulator assumed 5%.
- Lost Ring of Keys opens neighbors in **62.8%** (n=199), not 80%. Side doors opened without the Ring 157× in 6,944.
- Consumption: 1.12 bites per devour (n=155); the beast changed after a bite 73% of the time (matches a uniform re-roll = 75%).
- **Instrument offers (n=110 offers): Iron Crown and Elephant-Foot Maul 0×; Skewer, Tongs, Guillotine 2×; Iron Box 4×.** Beast-specific instruments are rare → Crown is the best solo but almost never shows up. Most offered: Scapegoat 19, Pestle 19, Hook 18, Keys 18, Stake 16.
- Actual Rainbows per run (114 runs with a full readout, the agent's calculation over the raw jsonl): **mean 2.04, median 2**, 25% with 0, max 8. Below the sim's 3.43 (biased sample, early league).

**Community (Oct 16–17)**
- Possible **cap of 10 Rainbows per run** (a comment + many "10彩" titles on Bilibili) — not confirmed.
- **Meat Grinder mode**: consumes 3× the nameplates, +50% drops (read on stream by DonTheCrown).
- Riot: 3 levels (上层/中层/下层), up to ~9 prisoners per level, **6 attempts** ("剩余挑战次数 6/6").
- The mechanic only appears 100% of the time on maps from **TM7** onward; relevant profit from TM7 onward (dev in an interview). K7 drops stacks of 1 FE; K8 stacks of 1/5/10/20.
- Anecdotal profit: ~1 FE per Rainbow in K7; ~20 FE/run (CoffeeBns, 7-2); 12–20 FE/run (Don).
- Twin Inquisitors C6 ≈ +40–48% loot — weaker than previous seasonal pets (Don live; pre-launch Reddit calculation).
- 吉吉罗's CN simulator stopped being updated on Oct 14; the EN one (CoffeeBns) keeps updating with live data.

## 2026-10-16 (night) — image analysis (`images/INDEX.md`, `images/mechanic_data.json`)

38 images verified and transcribed (official preview VOD in 1080p, press kit, official site, live screenshots from Bilibili/Reddit).

- **Run entry:** a live screenshot shows "1/12" on "Start Warden's Duty" and "1/48" in the inventory → **12 nameplates per run** (inferred from the UI; no explicit text).
- **Riot:** in 5 screens (VOD + 4 live), prisoners are sorted by descending rarity and distributed round-robin Upper → Middle → Lower.
- **10-Rainbow cap reinforced:** the 4 live runs with a riot screen have exactly 10 Chromatic; the containment panel has ~10 slots (visual count). Could still be bias in who posts.
- **Open conflict — second meal:** pre-launch images (01, 02) show Mammoth→Wolf and Lion→Rat already at Normal/Magic; the simulator says that live it only applies from Legendary+ (3 observations). The map stays at Legendary+; no live screenshot settles it yet.
- Full in-game beast names: Mammoth, **Berserk** Lion, **Alpha** Wolf, **Colossal** Rat. Rarity 5 appears as "Ultimate" (至臻) in the UI.

## 2026-10-16 (late night) — the team's own run + in-game rules; play board on the site

Source: screenshots of a run played by the team on the live EN client (`images/42`–`54`) and three more frames of the official preview VOD (`images/55`–`57`). Transcriptions in `images/INDEX.md`.

**Official (in-game rules screen, live client)**
- **Second meal — conflict leans to "every rarity":** the in-game "Devouring Relationship" diagram draws Mammoth→Wolf and Lion→Rat as default counters with no rarity condition, and the official preview VOD (1:51, 1:54) animates the same two extra arrows. Against it: the fan-sim's "Legendary+" (3 live observations). Still no live board that settles it; the play board follows the in-game diagram and has a toggle for the sim rule.
- **Instigate adds one Prison Incident to a random cell** (rules text). The guide said "2 events behind 2 locked doors" (simulator).
- There is a per-run limit of Chromatic inmates; the rules don't state the number (the "10" cap stays unconfirmed).
- Rarity names in the UI text: Normal, Magic, Rare, Legendary, **Ultimate**, **Chromatic**; colours white, blue, purple, orange, red, rainbow. The site's tier colours now follow them.

**Live (team run)**
- **12 nameplates per run confirmed:** Meat Grinder shows 36 = 3× (was inferred from "1/12").
- New objective **Behind Cell Doors** (open 10 cells): reward = 1 extra instrument **and** an Ultimate or Chromatic Warden's Cache at the riot. Not in the simulator.
- Iron Law (30-day run) seen as the start card; the instrument offer was Avenger's Casket / Lost Ring of Keys / Long-Chained Shackles.

**Site**
- `/ss14/` is now a one-screen **play board**: mirror the in-game board (game art), get the move for the day, the best of the 3 instruments offered, the incident verdict and the treasure for the current board. The previous long page moved to `/ss14/reference/`.
- Game art cut by `scripts/game_art.py` into `art/` (sources in `art/SOURCES.md`).

**Prison Incidents (team run, `images/58`–`63`)**
- **No skip:** all 6 live incident cards (and the 2 VOD cards) show only Confirm / View Prison Status. The simulator models accept/skip; in the game the decision is whether to step on a "!" cell. The play board's incident tab now says so.
- New incident **Shared Fortune**: +1 tier to the current inmate for each inmate with the same Code. Not in the simulator.
- Official card texts now on the site for Behind Closed Doors (Scarce Code = fewest on the board, 0 counts, random tie), "Treasure" Hunt (reveals, does not open), Taste of Freedom, Sewer Ratway, Chain Reaction, Execution Efficiency.

**Second team run (`images/64`–`67`)**
- **High-Risk Convict** card seen: opens 1 random cell with a Legendary or better inmate (no other effects) — matches the simulator.
- New instrument **Filthy Claws: Alpha Wolf** (each morning a Scratch Marks mark on 1 unopened cell). Not in the simulator; the site can't rank it yet.
- Objective **Undercurrents** (2 incidents) gives the same reward as Behind Cell Doors: 1 extra instrument + an Ultimate or Chromatic Warden's Cache at the riot.
- **Ravenous Appetite** card seen (`images/68`): a random lowest-rarity inmate gets 5 tries at +1 tier, 50% each — matches the simulator.

## 2026-10-17 — team run #2 played with the site (LIVE, n=1)

20-day run, stage level 79, objective Undercurrents, instruments Rusty Saw (start) + Kin's Coin of Fate (objective). Result: **5 Chromatic** (live median 2). What decided it:
- Behind Closed Doors made an Ultimate Mammoth; High-Risk Convict opened an Ultimate Lion → Ultimate eater + Ultimate prey.
- A Legendary Lion ate a Legendary Wolf, re-rolled into Mammoth and ate an Ultimate Lion in the same chain → Chromatic #1. Brass Horn then made the waiting Ultimate Mammoth eat → Chromatic #2.
- Kin's Coin twice turned a pair into +2 (Rare Lions → Ultimate; Legendary Wolves → Chromatic).
- Thumb Ring three times on a thin board refilled it with food; Rusty Saw's +1 closed at least one chain into Chromatic.
- Consume and End were the only options when standing on some opened cells (no Replace button) — not explained yet.

**Site:** `/ss14/` became a play sheet: the patterns above, the instrument pick and "take it when…" for treasures and incidents. The board-mirroring advisor was dropped (too conditional to solve; confusing in play).

## 2026-10-17 — live prints 75–77: Archenemy incident, Iron Crown sighted, Executioner's Blacklist (LIVE)

## 2026-10-17 — correction: Skewered Rat Heads is +2 live, not +1 (LIVE print 78)

- The live card (`images/78`) says Colossal Rat can consume Colossal Rats of the same rarity and gets **+2 additional Rarity Tiers after consuming**. The preview VOD card (print 37) said +1, and the simulator (20261016zzx) still applies +1 — while it applies the identical Iron Crown wording as +2. So the sim's value for Skewered Rat Heads (1.57 Rainbow/run, tier B) is an **underestimate**. The play sheet now says +2 and flags the tier; worth reporting to the simulator.
- **Fanged Guillotine: Alpha Wolf** full card seen (`images/79`): the Alpha Wolf can consume lower-rarity countered inmates, **triggering Oppress after consuming**. The simulator models only the first half; Oppress is not in it, so its value for the Guillotine (1.32, tier C) leaves that effect out. What Oppress does: **no data yet** (needs its tooltip).

## 2026-10-17 — Oppress defined (DATA, tlidb)

- **Oppress** (欺压), triggered by **Fanged Guillotine: Alpha Wolf** after the Wolf eats lower-rarity prey (`images/79`): *"Determines upgrade based on the difference in rarity between both parties. Reduces upgrade chance by 5% for each tier difference."* (https://tlidb.com/en/Oppress, same text on `cn/Oppress`). Those bites are no longer a sure +1; the simulator (20261016zzx, `gainFor()`) still gives a sure +1, so its Guillotine value (1.32, tier C) is a slight overestimate. Still open: the base chance and whether other cross-rarity bites trigger it. Guide §7 and §11 updated; the play sheet now explains Oppress.

## 2026-10-17 — live print 80: card texts scroll; Kin's Coin and Long-Chained Shackles complete (LIVE)

- A card's text box **scrolls** (`images/80`): the "cut-off" effects in earlier prints were cut by the scroll box, not by the game. Scrolling the card shows the rest — the way to finish the Maiden, Scapegoat's Guillotine, Burning Stake and Avenger's Casket cards.
- **Kin's Coin of Fate** full effect: removes 1 random matching inmate (same beast and rarity), then 1 random remaining matching inmate gets +2 tiers — matches the simulator.
- **Long-Chained Shackles** full effect: +1 tier to 1 random inmate — matches the simulator.
- **Forged Key** live card (`images/81`, scrolled): −1 daily destination; 50% after opening → opens 1 more random cell (no other effects). First live print (was VOD-only); matches the simulator.
- **The game log carries no card text or board state.** With the log on (`UE_game.log`), a full run writes only UI events: page names (`S16BoardMain`, `S16BoardRelicPop` = instrument pick, `S16BoardColoredPop` = Warden's Treasure), button clicks and sounds (`UI_S16_Prison_Relock`, `UI_S16_Own_Eat`, `UI_S16_Basic/Mid/Premium_Quality`). Internally the mode is `S16`. Good for a coarse run timeline (days, consumes, Rainbows), not for texts or odds.

## 2026-10-17 — live prints 82–84 (Ravenous Chains, Blood-Stained Trap, Prey) and the Tusk rule (LIVE)

- **Ferocious Beast's Ravenous Chains** first print (`images/82`): each morning, removes the inmates on both sides of the highest-rarity inmate; 40% for +1 tier to it per inmate removed. Matches the simulator and our engine.
- **Blood-Stained Trap: Berserk Lion** first print (`images/83`): when the warden stops on a Berserk Lion's cell, Hunt joins the day's choices and puts a Prey mark on an inmate the Lion can consume. **Prey** tooltip (`images/84`): lasts 3 rounds; Lion and prey +1 tier each morning; the mark goes when either is removed or changes Code. Matches the tlidb tooltip, the simulator and our engine.
- **Tusk stays through Replaces** (Iron Tongs of Lust: Mammoth): content creator **ALannister** (Reddit comment on the team's play sheet, 2026-10-17) says the mark only clears when its cell empties — the inmate is eaten or reaches Chromatic — and calls Tongs one of the best instruments ("a Rainbow printer"): keep Mammoths, never consume a Mammoth or an inmate in a Tusk cell, Replace on Tusk cells for +1 ×4. Agrees with the tlidb tooltip ("when there is no Inmate in this room"); the simulator also keeps the mark, so its low value (1.09, tier D) comes from how its player plays, not from the rule. Our engine now keeps the Tusk by default (`tusk_persists=true`): Tongs **1.88 → 2.38** Rainbows/run with rewards off (base 0.91), 4th of 31 instruments. Guide §7 updated.

## 2026-10-17 — live prints 85–88: Maiden fires after a Replace; Prison Walk; Chromatic cap 10 (LIVE)

- **Severed Iron Maiden** full card (`images/88`, scrolled): `+3 additional Rarity Tiers to the Inmate after this Replacement`. It fires **after a Replace**, on the new inmate, when its higher- and lower-tier counts are equal — as the simulator applies it. Our engine had read the cut card (print 73) as "any time"; its default is now `maiden_any_time=false` (Maiden 4.19 → ~2.37 Rainbows/run with rewards off). The play sheet's text was already right; its "!" is removed.
- **Hangman's Noose** first live card (`images/88`): after replacing, Normal and Magic inmates don't appear — matches the simulator.
- **Prison Walk** first print (`images/85`): move 18 tiles; same reward as the other objectives (1 more instrument + an Ultimate or Chromatic Warden's Cache in the Riot). Matches the simulator and our engine.
- Tooltips (`images/86`, `87`): a **Torture Instrument** stays active for the whole run; a **Warden's Cache** is carried by each Chromatic and each inmate left at the end, at its rarity, and is unlocked by defeating that inmate in the Riot.
- **Chromatic cap = 10 per run**, confirmed by the owner's play (was "possible, not confirmed" on Oct 16). Our engine already uses 10.

## 2026-10-17 — live prints 89–93: Extra Portion (new incident), incidents refill, Scapegoat and the 4 treasures complete (LIVE)

- **Extra Portion** (`images/93`) — a Prison Incident **not in the simulator** nor in any earlier source: up to 3 random inmates +1 tier. Added to our engine (incident pool now 12 + Usurpation, still uniform: no live rate per incident) and to the play sheet's incidents.
- **Incidents refill** (owner's play, prints 92 → 94): when an incident triggers, a new one appears on another cell, so the board always holds at least one "!"; Instigate adds 1 on top. Our engine now starts every run with at least one and refills after each trigger (`incident_respawn=true`); before, incidents came only at the start (6.4% of cells) and from Instigate. The simulator has no refill.
- **Scapegoat's Guillotine** full card (`images/89`, scrolled): removes 2 other inmates to guarantee the new inmate's rarity rises after the Replace — matches the simulator and our engine.
- **The 4 Warden's Treasures** on the live client (`images/91`), with Brand of Original Sin complete: up to 4 inmates with no Consumable target change Code so they have one. Same as the preview video; matches our engine. The play sheet now shows what each treasure does next to when to take it.
- **Hunt** shows as a fourth decision button (Consume, Replace, Hunt, End) when the warden stops on a Berserk Lion with the Blood-Stained Trap (`images/92`) — it is the day's decision, as the simulator and our engine apply it.
- Behind Closed Doors flavor complete (`images/90`).

## 2026-10-17 (night) — our engine is the only source of numbers; Cage Fight and Viktor (LIVE + ENGINE)

- **The play sheet's numbers now come only from our engine** (`engine/`, `data/engine_results.json`), owner's call. The community Tartarus Simulator is no longer a source: its rules lag the live cards (Maiden, Collar, Muzzle, Skewer, Oppress, Shared Fortune, Archenemy, Extra Portion, the incident refill) and its board reader never records an incident on an open cell (0 of 22,000 incidents read were on open cells, while live boards show them there — e.g. `images/92`, cell 16). Its analyzer's live odds (door, Replace, offers, frozen at 2026-10-16) are still used, for lack of another sample.
- **Engine:** the instrument pick ranks offers by our own solo values; the player keeps Tusk cells and Mammoths when holding Iron Tongs (Tongs 2.87 → 3.05); `--objective` fixes the run's objective; `export` adds `byStart` (each start card: base, instruments, pairs) and `byObjective` (rewards on). Results (100k runs per test, 2026-10-17): no instrument 1.39 Rainbows/run; full run with rewards 3.41 (median 3); best solos Crown 3.05, Tongs 3.05, Claws 3.02. Start cards reorder the ranking — Cage Fight puts Lost Ring of Keys on top (5.43, base 3.54), Iron Law Tongs (6.33, base 2.68), Tyranny Hangman's Noose (6.38, base 4.13); the objective moves the values but barely the order.
- **Cage Fight** first print (`images/95`): consume lower-rarity countered inmates, and consuming doesn't change the Code — matches the engine. Start cards come from **Viktor**, a boss met on the maps (owner). Counter tooltip (`images/96`) matches tlidb.

- **Raging Beast's Agonizing Muzzle** live card (owner's run, 2026-10-17; the print was overwritten before it was copied, text in `images/INDEX.md`): `When there are no more than 4 Inmates on the field, after Consuming` → +2. The preview VOD card (print 34) said 3. **Engine default `muzzle_max` 3 → 4**; re-export: Muzzle solo 1.69 → 1.99 Rainbows/run (rank 19 → 15 of 31), and with Cage Fight 5.13 → 5.71, now the best first instrument there (Lost Ring of Keys 5.42).

## 2026-10-18 — Usurpation is a chain (prints 102–105), second meals at every rarity, incidents ranked (LIVE + ENGINE)

- **Usurpation I–IV** first prints (`images/102`–`105`, the owner's run): I +1 tier to 1 inmate · **II +2 tiers to 1 inmate** (our engine and sheet had +1 to 2) · III +2 to 2 · IV +2 to all. Each card "adds the next to Prison Incidents and removes itself"; in play, **the next incidents the owner triggered were II, III and IV in turn** (day 14 → 10 → 7 → 6), and no "!" appeared when a stage fired. Engine: II fixed, and once I fires the next incident triggered is the next stage (`rules::fires`); it no longer plants the next stage behind a locked door.
- **Second meals at every rarity** (Mammoth eats Wolf, Lion eats Rat below Legendary too): players' boards show the jaws on those eaters 120 with / 3 without (community analyzer, 349 boards) and 149 / 7 (tartarus-simulator issue #5, 168 boards), and the game offered those Consumes (its reports 206, 208). At Normal the game leaves the jaws off ~46% of the time even with a meal. Engine default `second_meal_from` 3 → 0.
- **Re-export** (2,162 tests × 100,000 runs): no instrument 1.39 → 1.49; **Elephant-Foot Maul 2.49 → 3.23, now the best solo** (Claws 3.14, Crown 3.13, Tongs 3.12); Muzzle 1.99 → 2.41; Collar 2.59 → 2.82; Blood-Stained Trap 2.02 → 2.34; Tyranny base 4.12 → 4.98.
- **Incidents ranked** (new in the export: the run with its first "!" forced to each kind, against an ordinary run): Usurpation **+1.49**, Behind Closed Doors +0.19, Extra Portion +0.17, High-Risk Convict +0.04, Ravenous Appetite +0.01, Taste of Freedom −0.07, Shared Fortune −0.18, Chain Reaction −0.20, Archenemy −0.23, Sewer Ratway −0.25, Execution Efficiency −0.29, Crow Whispers −0.37, "Treasure" Hunt −0.41.
- **Crow Whispers** (`images/97`): owner's play — the 4 cells go clockwise from the warden and skip occupied cells, as the engine does. **Crowded Beastcage, Avenger's Casket, Searing Branding Iron** full cards (`images/98`–`100`); the Branding Iron's copy lands in an opened cell (`images/101`).
